# AI Usage Log

Transparent record of AI assistance for the Eduvos Hack Jam 2026. Tool: Claude Code (Claude Sonnet 5.5).

## Phase 0 — Scaffold
**Generated by Claude Code:** Next.js project scaffold, layout/header/bottom-nav/footer, design tokens,
PWA manifest and service worker, generated PWA icons (navy tile with sand "V"), Supabase client helpers,
health-check route, all documentation files.

**Sourced externally:** Eduvos logo downloaded from https://www.eduvos.com/logo.png (referenced in the
site header). Confirm we have permission to use it for the Hack Jam.

**Verified:** `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm run build` pass. `/api/health` returns 503
`not_configured` until the anon key is set in `.env.local`; manifest served with HTTP 200.

**Not yet verified:** Supabase connectivity (anon key not yet provided); Lighthouse and 360px manual
check on a real phone; contrast ratios were computed by hand, not with a tool.

## Phase 1 — Database, auth and roles
**Generated by Claude Code:** all four SQL migrations (schema, RLS policies, guard triggers, sign-up gate,
storage buckets, reference data), `scripts/seed.mjs` (demo staff, 8 sellers, 32 listings, generated
placeholder images), `scripts/rls-test.mjs`, `scripts/db-audit.mjs`, `docs/DATA_MODEL.md`, generated types.

**Human decisions:** sign-up domains (`vossie.net` + `eduvos.com` + one named test address), roles by
promotion only, dev-only demo password for seeded users.

**Verified:** migrations applied to the live project; 30 automated security checks pass; advisor-style audit
reports 0 issues. The hosted Supabase advisors were not run (not reachable through the CLI), so the audit
script approximates them: please also open Dashboard -> Advisors and confirm.

**Caveats:** demo images are generated illustrations, not real photos. Demo users share one password and the
seed script must never be run against a production database.

## Phase 4 — Messaging, enquiry management and trust (MVP)
**Generated by Claude Code:** six SQL migrations (conversations/messages/enquiries upgrades, guard and rate-limit triggers, notifications,
trust tiers/score, private image bucket, Realtime, cron), server actions, the thread/inbox/composer/bell/dashboard components, trust pages,
the seed extension, `scripts/messaging-test.mjs`, `scripts/two-user-flow.mjs`, docs.

**Human decisions:** tier names and thresholds (rules stored in a config table, not code), seed data that shows every tier, skip email for now,
push behind a flag only, a Phase 3 test-fix pass before any Phase 4 feature work.

**Verified:** lint, typecheck, build; `test:messaging` 83/83 (non-participants, mentors and anonymous visitors cannot read threads; sellers cannot
write trust or tier rules; buyers cannot change status except confirming; rate limits; private images); `test:flow` 46/46 in a real browser at 360px
with two isolated sessions; `test:ui` 67/67; `test:rls` 30/30; `test:smoke` 31/31. The 7-day auto-confirm was exercised in a rolled-back transaction.
Hosted Supabase advisors: security clean (one INFO: `email_queue` intentionally has no policies); performance fixes applied.

**Bugs the end-to-end test caught (and we fixed):** a modal that stole focus on every keystroke, and a completion dialog that a slow request
could close. **Not verified:** real devices (iOS Safari Realtime and file picker), screen readers, `test:discovery`/`db:audit` (need `DATABASE_URL`,
not available this session), email (no provider), web push (flag only).

**Caveats:** trust is deliberately conservative: WhatsApp leads cannot be measured so they do not count for or against a seller. Message text is
visible to admins (moderation) but not to mentors.

## Phase 5 — Safety, moderation, admin panel, mentor layer and POPIA
**Generated by Claude Code:** five SQL migrations (reports and context snapshots, auto-hide, suspension and ban enforcement, append-only audit log,
admin SQL functions, mentor tables, Hub Growth, account deletion and scrub, nightly jobs), server actions, the admin, mentor, Growth and privacy
pages and components, a safe markdown renderer, the seed extension, `scripts/moderation-test.mjs`, `scripts/phase5-flow.mjs`, the privacy policy text,
`docs/EMAIL_SETUP.md` and the doc updates.

**Human decisions:** auto-hide threshold of 3 unique reporters; the Information Officer is an editable setting with a placeholder until the Hub names one;
data export runs as a Next.js route handler (not an Edge Function); no Phase 4 bugs were reported, so only baseline checks drove fixes.

**Verified:** lint, typecheck, build; `test:moderation` 161/161 (reporter identity hidden, 10/day limit, auto-hide at 3 unique reporters, suspended
users cannot list or message, audit log append-only even for the service role, last admin protected, buyers and sellers cannot reach admin functions,
mentors cannot read messages or unassigned sellers, Hub rules, account deletion keeps others' history); `test:phase5` 134/134 in a real browser at 360px
with separate sessions (role gating, approve -> seller sees it -> report -> auto-hide -> admin restores, suspension notice, mentor view and CSV, Hub,
privacy policy, data export, delete account); earlier suites still green (`test:rls` 30, `test:messaging` 83, `test:smoke` 31, `test:ui`, `test:flow` 46).
Hosted Supabase advisors: no new security findings.

**Bugs the new tests caught (and we fixed):** `admin_set_role` wrote its audit row after demoting the caller, which an admin stepping down could not do;
tap targets on two admin links; a test that looked inside a collapsed section.

**Not verified (please check):** real devices, screen readers, the legal wording of the privacy policy (a draft for Eduvos legal to review), the
30-day hard-delete job (it only runs after 30 days; the logic was reviewed but not run end to end), actual email delivery (no SMTP yet: see
`docs/EMAIL_SETUP.md`), Hub cover-image upload (code path reviewed, not exercised in the browser), `test:discovery` and `db:audit` (need `DATABASE_URL`).

**Caveats:** mentors' "recently hidden" flag counts any moderation hide, not only automatic ones. Audit entries written by the automated tests stay in the
log forever by design (their reasons start with "[automated test]"). Admins can read reporter names; the reported person never can.

## Rebrand stage 2: design system, Unicons, mobile
**ui-ux-pro-max contributed:** the design-system generator run (dials 6/4/5), the "Vibrant & Block-based" style entry, the UX rules and the pre-delivery checklist now in `MASTER.md`.
We did **not** adopt its output as-is: it proposed a purple palette, "Minimalism" and swapped our fonts, so MASTER.md was rewritten by hand with our palette, fonts and themes.
**21st contributed:** search results for a product card, bottom sheet, empty state and toast (previews and descriptions), plus the source of the *Product Card* (compound image well, overlaid
save badge, press-to-lift) and *BeUI Bottom Sheet* (drag handle, scroll lock, reduced-motion handling). The free tier allowed 2 code retrievals a day, so the empty state, stat tile, tabs and toast were built
from our own tokens without their code. **Adaptation:** no shadcn, `cn` helper or `motion` dependency was added; both were rewritten with Tailwind classes, our tokens, `next/image` and plain pointer events.
**Generated by Claude Code:** `Icon`/`Verified`/`Toast`/`StatTile`/`LinkTabs`, the card and filter-sheet changes, `scripts/responsive-audit.mjs`, `docs/UI_AUDIT.md`.
**Verified:** audit 0 issues at 6 widths in light and dark; `test:ui`, `test:theme`, `test:phase5`, `test:flow`, `test:smoke` pass; screenshots of browse and home read at 360px.
**Not verified (please check):** real iPhone safe areas and the drag-to-dismiss sheet on a touchscreen, screen-reader announcements of the new toast, how Unicons look to your eye next to the Figma file,
delivery icons on cards (they need the Stage 7 data, so the card has no delivery row yet), and the "stat tile" and "tabs" components (built, only `LinkTabs` is used so far).
